validations.detection_name: Cisco Secure Firewall - React Server Components RCE Attempt
adaptations: Scoped the reviewed cisco_secure_firewall macro to the authorized index, run ID, sourcetype, and 15-minute window.
Mapped documented JSON fields to the upstream detection fields.
Removed display-only security_content_ctime formatting for portable execution.
Expanded the upstream empty filter macro.
limitations: Attack Data replay is curated historical evidence, not NetSpout-native device telemetry.
This validation does not establish production detection efficacy.
The shared streaming export client does not expose a durable Splunk search job ID.
Windows/endpoint and identity/authentication targets remain unvalidated because no evidence-backed compatible source and reviewed executable dependency set was established.
